results.question: 各门店销售额排名
sqls: SELECT s.store_name, s.region, COUNT(o.order_id) as orders, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount),0) as sales FROM store s LEFT JOIN orders o ON s.id=o.store_id GROUP BY s.id, s.store_name, s.region ORDER BY sales DESC

results.question: 华东区近30天销售额最高的门店是哪个
sqls: SELECT s.store_name, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount),0) as sales FROM store s LEFT JOIN orders o ON s.id=o.store_id AND o.create_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' WHERE s.region = '华东' GROUP BY s.id, s.store_name ORDER BY sales DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: 各区域销售额占比
sqls: SELECT s.region, COUNT(o.order_id) as orders, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount),0) as sales, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(o.amount),0) * 100.0 / SUM(SUM(o.amount)) OVER (), 2) as sales_share FROM store s LEFT JOIN orders o ON s.id = o.store_id GROUP BY s.region ORDER BY sales DESC

SELECT s.region, COUNT(o.order_id) as orders, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount),0) as sales, ROUND((COALESCE(SUM(o.amount),0) * 100.0 / SUM(SUM(o.amount)) OVER ())::numeric, 2) as sales_share FROM store s LEFT JOIN orders o ON s.id = o.store_id GROUP BY s.region ORDER BY sales DESC

results.question: 各区域订单数对比
sqls: SELECT s.region, COUNT(o.order_id) as orders, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount),0) as sales FROM store s LEFT JOIN orders o ON s.id=o.store_id GROUP BY s.region ORDER BY orders DESC

results.question: 分析华东区最近销售情况
sqls: SELECT s.region, COUNT(o.order_id) as orders, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount),0) as sales, COALESCE(SUM(o.refund_amount),0) as refund_amount, COUNT(CASE WHEN o.refund_amount>0 THEN 1 END) as refund_orders FROM store s LEFT JOIN orders o ON s.id=o.store_id WHERE s.region='华东' GROUP BY s.region

SELECT DATE(o.create_time) as date, COUNT(*) as orders, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount),0) as sales FROM orders o JOIN store s ON o.store_id=s.id WHERE s.region='华东' AND o.create_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY DATE(o.create_time) ORDER BY date

SELECT s.store_name, COUNT(o.order_id) as orders, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount),0) as sales, COALESCE(SUM(o.refund_amount),0) as refund_amount FROM store s LEFT JOIN orders o ON s.id=o.store_id WHERE s.region='华东' GROUP BY s.id, s.store_name ORDER BY sales DESC

results.question: 对比华东和华北两个区域的销售表现
sqls: SELECT s.region, COUNT(o.order_id) as orders, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount),0) as sales, COALESCE(SUM(o.refund_amount),0) as refund_amount FROM store s LEFT JOIN orders o ON s.id=o.store_id WHERE s.region IN ('华东','华北') GROUP BY s.region ORDER BY sales DESC
SELECT region, COUNT(*) as store_count FROM store WHERE region IN ('华东','华北') GROUP BY region

results.question: 分析各区域销售额的同比变化
sqls: SELECT MIN(create_time) AS min_time, MAX(create_time) AS max_time, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM create_time) AS yr FROM orders GROUP BY yr ORDER BY yr

SELECT s.region, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.create_time) AS yr, COUNT(o.order_id) AS orders, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount),0) AS sales FROM store s LEFT JOIN orders o ON s.id = o.store_id GROUP BY s.region, yr ORDER BY s.region, yr

WITH y AS (
  SELECT s.region,
         SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.create_time)=2025 THEN o.amount ELSE 0 END) AS sales_2025,
         SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.create_time)=2026 THEN o.amount ELSE 0 END) AS sales_2026
  FROM store s LEFT JOIN orders o ON s.id=o.store_id
  GROUP BY s.region
)
SELECT region,
       ROUND(sales_2025,2) AS sales_2025,
       ROUND(sales_2026,2) AS sales_2026,
       ROUND((sales_2026 - sales_2025)*100.0 / NULLIF(sales_2025,0), 2) AS yoy_growth_pct
FROM y
ORDER BY yoy_growth_pct DESC

results.question: 上月销售冠军门店的成功因素分析
sqls: SELECT s.store_name, s.region, s.manager, COUNT(o.order_id) as total_orders, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount),0) as sales FROM store s LEFT JOIN orders o ON s.id=o.store_id WHERE o.create_time >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 month') AND o.create_time < DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY s.id, s.store_name, s.region, s.manager ORDER BY sales DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT MIN(create_time) as min_time, MAX(create_time) as max_time, DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) as cur_month_start FROM orders

SELECT s.store_name, COUNT(o.order_id) as total_orders, COUNT(CASE WHEN o.refund_amount>0 THEN 1 END) as refund_orders, COALESCE(SUM(o.refund_amount),0) as refund_amount, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN o.refund_amount>0 THEN 1 END)*100.0/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0),2) as refund_rate, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(o.amount),0)/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0),2) as avg_order_value FROM orders o JOIN store s ON o.store_id=s.id WHERE o.create_time >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 month') AND o.create_time < DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) AND s.store_name='郑州万达店' GROUP BY s.store_name

results.question: 退款最多的那个门店的会员情况
sqls: SELECT s.id, s.store_name, COALESCE(SUM(o.refund_amount),0) AS total_refund, COUNT(CASE WHEN o.refund_amount>0 THEN 1 END) AS refund_orders, COUNT(o.order_id) AS total_orders FROM store s LEFT JOIN orders o ON s.id=o.store_id GROUP BY s.id, s.store_name ORDER BY total_refund DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT m.level, COUNT(DISTINCT o.member_id) AS members, COUNT(o.order_id) AS orders, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount),0) AS sales FROM orders o JOIN member m ON o.member_id=m.member_id WHERE o.store_id=86 GROUP BY m.level ORDER BY members DESC

SELECT m.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT o.member_id) AS members, COUNT(o.order_id) AS orders, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount),0) AS sales FROM orders o JOIN member m ON o.member_id=m.member_id WHERE o.store_id=86 GROUP BY m.gender ORDER BY members DESC
